name: Vantacide
description: A targeted neuroactive compound that floods the BCI's wireless transmission architecture with pharmacologically-generated electromagnetic noise, effectively jamming all BCI signal output and input. The subject's BCI becomes a useless brick — no comms, no augment control signals, no neural net access, no emergency beacon. In a society where BCI is as essential as breathing, Vantacide is a form of sensory and functional amputation.
effects: full BCI signal disruption — all wireless BCI functions offline
augment control signals severed (chrome limbs, optical implants, and neural interfaces go dark)
subject cut off from all network access and communications
BCI reads as 'offline' to external scanners — subject becomes invisible to digital tracking
side_effects: subjects with deep neural integration experience BCI severance as acute psychological pain — described as sudden deafness, blindness, and isolation simultaneously
chrome limbs default to manual mode — some advanced augments lock up entirely
subjects with SNT-integrated implants may experience partial seizures as SNT tissue attempts to compensate for severed signals
re-connection on drug clearance causes 'flood effect' — sudden re-integration of all pending signals can cause disorientation or cardiac arrhythmia
subjects without BCI are unaffected — rare in 2200
cultural_context: Used by kidnappers to prevent emergency beacon activation, by thieves to blind security-augmented guards, and by operators who need to move a target through an area without leaving a digital trace. Also used in Shelf power plays — dosing a rival's crew before a hit means they can't call for backup. The phrase 'Nulled out' in GLMZ street slang means completely cut off, digitally invisible, and vulnerable.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive is dosed with Vantacide at a public event — someone wants them digitally blind for exactly four hours. What happens in those four hours is the story.

A runner discovers that the Shelf neighborhood they're operating in has had its water supply micro-dosed with diluted Vantacide — someone has been BCi-blinding an entire community, and the locals don't know why.
A Nightshade chemist offers to sell the synthesis route for Vantacide to a corpo security firm. The offer is a trap — or is it?
